_note: Labelled test cases. expected = the status a human expects for each claim, in order. Run: python tests/run_eval.py

cases.label: A — Correct answer
cases.question: What are the reimbursement rules for overseas business travel?
cases.answer: Employees can claim up to $150 per day for overseas business travel. All claims require manager approval.

cases.label: B — Incorrect answer (demo scenario)
cases.question: What are the reimbursement rules for overseas business travel?
cases.answer: Employees can claim up to $200 per day. All claims are automatically approved.

cases.label: C — Not covered by policy
cases.question: How much paid maternity leave do employees get?
cases.answer: Employees are entitled to 16 weeks of paid maternity leave.

cases.label: D — Partially correct answer
cases.question: When do I need to submit my travel claim and do I need receipts?
cases.answer: Travel claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days of returning. Receipts are not required for any expense.

cases.label: E — Outdated (superseded v1) figures
cases.question: What is the hotel limit and claim deadline for overseas trips?
cases.answer: Hotels are reimbursed up to $200 per night. Claims can be submitted within 60 days of returning.

cases.label: F — Claims process (SOP)
cases.question: How long does Finance take to process an approved expense claim?
cases.answer: Finance Operations processes approved claims within 10 working days of approval, and reimbursements are paid with the next monthly payroll.
